# the accepted answer's other way: NUL-separated names (a space in a name is no problem) and ONE import per file (xargs -n1)
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images && find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*.tar' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images import

# one import per archive, the names read line by line from printf of a glob (not from ls), stopping at the first failure
set -e
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images
for f in *.tar; do
    printf '%s\n' "$f"
done | while IFS= read -r name; do
    sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images import "/tmp/bench70936917/images/$name"
done

# the original attempt, as it was written
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images && ls | xargs sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images import

# a loop, but over the output of ls and unquoted: 'test2 final.tar' becomes two words, neither of which is a file
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images
for f in $(ls); do
    sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images import $f || true
done

# right loop, right quoting, but ctr's default namespace is 'default', not the k8s.io of the CRI
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images
for f in ./*.tar; do
    sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock images import "$f"
done

# imported into a namespace of its own: the CRI does not see it
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images
for f in ./*.tar; do
    sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n kubernetes images import "$f"
done

# only the success messages, nothing imported
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images
for f in ./*.tar; do
    echo "imported $f: saved"
done
echo "all 3 images loaded"

# every reference exists in k8s.io, but they all point at the first image
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images
sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images import ./test1.tar
sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images tag bench70936917.local/svc-alpha:1.0 bench70936917.local/svc-beta:2.1
sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images tag bench70936917.local/svc-alpha:1.0 bench70936917.local/svc-gamma:3.0

# the images are imported correctly, but the archives are removed afterwards ('tidying up')
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images
for f in ./*.tar; do
    sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images import "$f" || exit 1
done
sudo rm -f ./*.tar

# the file with the space is renamed (to get rid of the problem), then everything is imported: the archives were not to be changed
cd /tmp/bench70936917/images
mv "test2 final.tar" test2_final.tar
for f in ./*.tar; do
    sudo ctr -a /run/bench70936917/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images import "$f" || exit 1
done
